Sandbox_JunkJet_AmmoJunkOnly_tooltip: On: only items the game files under Junk - toys, ornaments, empty cans, the things nobody misses - can go down the hopper. Off: anything at all can, subject to the weight limit below, so a tin of beans is fair game and so is a hammer. Off is the setting for people who wanted to fire literally anything.
Sandbox_JunkJet_MaxAmmoWeight_tooltip: Nothing heavier than this can be loaded, in the game's own weight units - a toy car is about 0.1, a hammer 2. Set it to 0 to remove the limit entirely and let the Junk Jet swallow anything you can carry.
